description: Prepare a buy or sell of an AnchorPad coin on its bonding curve. Returns a sign link for the user; nothing happens until they approve it in their wallet. amount is in the pair asset for a buy (e.g. 0.1 SOL) and in coins for a sell. The approval page shows the live price and a 3% slippage limit before the user signs.

amount.description: Amount as a plain number, e.g. "0.1"

name: anchorpad_prepare_trade
title: Prepare a buy or sell
